skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and analyze the basic indicators of health.
Analyze the structure and history of the healthcare system in Vietnam.
Understand and analyze the machinery and policies for managing healthcare in Vietnam.
Analyze the overall health policy and the system of health policies in Vietnam.
Understand and analyze the general overview and management of hospitals.
Understand and analyze the socialization of healthcare and its implementation methods.
Apply knowledge of healthcare management to analyze, evaluate, and propose solutions for practical situations in healthcare management.
Demonstrate effective communication and presentation skills.
Demonstrate negotiation, teamwork, and group management skills.
Use economic and social research methods to analyze healthcare management issues and make decisions.
Analyze, advise, critique, plan, organize, supervise, and evaluate healthcare policies, programs, and projects.
Demonstrate ability to work independently or in teams under changing conditions.
Demonstrate ability to identify and solve problems in practical healthcare management.
Demonstrate a spirit of service, social responsibility, and professional ethics.
Develop self-learning abilities and adapt to changes.
